title: Legia Warszawa Lead Wire-to-Wire to Win the Polish U19 Title
description: Profbud Legia Warszawa are the best under-19 men's team in Poland, beating Energa Trefl 1LO Sopot 91-78 in the final of the championship tournament in Sopot. The team coached by Michal Spychala and Milosz Warecki led from start to finish, controlling the game throughout to claim the national title. WKK Wroclaw took third place, edging Exact Forestall Slask Wroclaw 72-69 in the bronze-medal game. Legia built their advantage early and never surrendered the lead, pulling away behind a balanced and efficient offense. The Warszawa side shot 50 percent from two, 38.5 percent from three and a sizzling 92 percent from the free-throw line as a team.
imageCaption: Legia Warszawa Lead Wire-to-Wire to Win the Polish U19 Title (Photo: PZKOSZ)

title: WKK Wroclaw have won U19 Championship!
description: WKK Wroclaw have won Polish U19 Championship. They overcame Exact Forestall Slask Wroclaw 85-74. Jakub Galewski (180-PG-2007) stepped up with 22 points and Karol Prochorowicz (201-F/C-2007) notched 21. Bruno Chalicki (190-SG-2007) followed them with 11 points in a win. Bartosz Ptak (200-SF-2006) replied with 30 points in the losing effort. Top-5 Borys Baran (195-G-2006) (Exact Forestall Slask Wroclaw) Bruno Chalicki (WKK Wroclaw)
imageCaption: WKK Wroclaw have won U19 Championship! (Photo: PZKosz)

title: GTK Gliwice clinch U19 Championship title
description: GTK Gliwice are 2024 U19 Polish champions. They overcame Enea Basket Poznan 88-75 for the trophy. Milosz Majewski (194-G/F-2007) scored 28 points, while Filip Poradzki added 18 points for the champions. Enea Poznan grabbed a 16-14 lead after ten minutes. But GTK Gliwice responded with a 27-14 rally in the second period to snatch the lead. The teams went neck and neck throughout the second half as GTK Gliwice managed to eke out a narrow victory. Rafal Szpakowski (184-G-2005) netted 23 points, while Iwo Baganc (203-SF-2006) topscored with 25 points and grabbed 12 rebounds in the loss.
imageCaption: GTK Gliwice clinch U19 Championship title (Photo: PZKosz)
